painPoints.title: Sound familiar?
painPoints.subtitle: Most teams know qualitative research is essential. The problem is everything around it.

items.title: Scheduling is the bottleneck
items.desc: You have a research question. You don't have 2 weeks to coordinate calendars with 15 participants across time zones.

items.title: Synthesis eats your time
items.desc: You're spending more hours tagging and re-reading transcripts than actually thinking about what the data means.

items.title: Stakeholders won't wait
items.desc: Product decisions are moving forward before your research is ready. Speed matters, but depth shouldn't be sacrificed.

items.title: No dedicated researcher on the team
items.desc: You know you should talk to users. You just don't have the bandwidth to recruit, schedule, moderate, transcribe, and synthesise.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps from research question to stakeholder-ready memo.

steps.title: Describe your research goal
steps.desc: Chat with the Research Copilot or paste your brief. The AI drafts your interview guide — objectives, screening criteria, and questions. You review and refine. Five minutes, not five hours.

steps.title: Participants interview on their own time
steps.desc: Share one link. Participants complete a voice interview in their browser — any device, any timezone. The AI asks follow-ups like a trained interviewer. No scheduling, no no-shows.

steps.title: Read the memo, skip the transcripts
steps.desc: Trigger an AI synthesis. Get structured themes with supporting quotes, tensions, and recommendations — ready to share with stakeholders. Chain multiple studies into a multi-step research plan.

copilot.title: Your always-on research partner
copilot.subtitle: The Research Copilot turns a rough question into a usable study, suggests next actions, and keeps context across your research program.

quality.title: Built to feel natural, and stay auditable
quality.subtitle: AI moderation is only useful if participants can answer comfortably and researchers can trace every insight back to the source.

items.title: The guide flexes when an answer matters
items.desc: QualiPulse follows your interview guide, then asks contextual probes when participants mention a pain point, workaround, decision moment, or contradiction.

items.title: A voice interview in the browser
items.desc: Participants open one link, answer on desktop or mobile, and complete the interview in their own time. No app install, no calendar coordination.

items.title: Every theme stays connected to evidence
items.desc: Research memos include supporting quotes and participant context, with transcripts available for review, tagging, export, and stakeholder follow-up.

output.title: From 12 interviews to this — automatically
output.subtitle: This is what your AI-generated research memo looks like. Themes, quotes, tensions, and recommendations — ready to share.
output.summaryText: Participants consistently reported that initial setup complexity is the primary barrier to adoption. Most valued a guided onboarding experience but found current implementations overly generic. Three key themes emerged around time-to-value expectations, the role of social proof in building confidence, and frustrations with feature discovery.
output.theme1Quote: "I need to see value in the first 10 minutes or I'm gone. I don't have time to watch tutorials."
output.theme2Quote: "I only found out about the export feature after three months. I'd been doing it manually."
output.rec1: Implement a task-based onboarding flow that delivers value within the first session
output.rec2: Add contextual feature hints triggered by user behaviour patterns
output.rec3: Create role-specific setup paths (researcher vs. PM vs. designer)

items.question: Do I need to recruit participants?
items.answer: QualiPulse gives you shareable links for your own participants. Panel recruitment is separate, so you stay in control of who you interview.

items.question: What counts as a credit?
items.answer: Only completed participant interviews consume credits. Screened-out, abandoned, and technically failed interviews do not.

items.question: What do participants install?
items.answer: Nothing. They open a link and complete a voice interview in the browser on desktop or mobile.

items.question: Can I buy more interviews?
items.answer: Yes. You can upgrade plans or buy prepaid credit packs when a study needs more responses.
